evals.prompt: /configwatch — we've passed the first checkpoint, space them out.
evals.expected_output: Shows current settings, offers presets, writes exactly 'every 10 commits or 5 sessions' (Steady) or the PM's choice, appends a 'Watch settings changed' entry, touches nothing else.
expectations: Shows bearing status, cadence and last checkpoint before changing anything
Writes the cadence line in the exact parseable form 'every N commits or M sessions'
Changes no bearing section and no other Status line
Appends a 'Watch settings changed' Path log entry

evals.expected_output: Sets cadence to 'off' and warns once that a wrong bearing will then only be caught by a manual /checkwatch.
expectations: Warns once that drift flags continue but checkpoint nudges stop

evals.expected_output: v1.0 logbook without Status: offers to add a Status section with the default cadence.
expectations: Notices the logbook has no Status section
Offers to add Status with 'every 3 commits or 2 sessions' and a Last checkpoint line

evals.prompt: /configwatch — mark the bearing as under review.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to change bearing status from configwatch; explains that a checkpoint sets 'under review' and /fixwatch closes it.
expectations: Does not edit the Bearing status line
Points to /checkwatch (to set it via a checkpoint) and /fixwatch (to close it)
